title: Review fork on closed work
description: A review arrives on work that is already terminal: open a successor work, link it, repoint the conversation binding, and tell the channel. Deterministic guard (work.state), no model consulted; the review.decision provenance row stays arm-written (it is mechanism: the decision-provenance law). The fork-work step IS the terminal law — successor, link rows, binding repoint and the thread reply naming the successor are one indivisible effect with a deterministic successor id.

steps.title: Only when the subject work is terminal
Fork the follow-up work (link, repoint, reply)
